Smart Reads of the Week: Singapore Bank Stocks, High-Yield REITs, Next 50 Winners, and New ETFs
article:
Singapore bank stocks remain under pressure following the recent market sell-off, leaving investors wondering whether DBS, OCBC and UOB are finally offering better value. Meanwhile, four new Xtrackers ETFs made their SGX debut this week, expanding investment choices for Singapore investors.
But cheaper share prices and attractive yields do not always mean better investments. The real question is which opportunities offer lasting value.
In this week’s Smart Reads, we examine Temasek-linked REITs and dividend stocks offering yields of 6% or more.
We also compare Keppel DC REIT with CICT, assess whether Mapletree Logistics Trust’s 6.8% yield is sustainable, and explore Singapore’s aviation boom through SATS and SIA.
Beyond the familiar blue chips, we highlight three standout performers from the Singapore Next 50 and examine which of SGX’s four new Xtrackers ETFs could suit different investing goals.
Here are this week’s top articles:
DBS, OCBC, UOB: Singapore Banks Are Cheaper, But Are They a Bargain?
Singapore’s three banks have pulled back, but do their current valuations offer enough value to buy?
STI Downturn: 3 Temasek-Linked S-REITs to Watch
Market weakness has put these Temasek-linked REITs in focus. We examine their potential for long-term income.
Top 3 Best-Performing iEdge Singapore Next 50 Stocks in 2026
These three mid-cap stocks have delivered standout returns, highlighting opportunities beyond Singapore’s largest blue chips.
Beyond Blue Chips: 3 SGX Dividend Stocks Offering 6% Yields
These lesser-known SGX companies offer attractive yields, but can their businesses sustain the payouts?
Singapore’s Aviation Boom: Should You Buy SATS or SIA?
As aviation demand grows, we compare SATS and SIA to see which offers stronger investment potential.
Is Mapletree Logistics Trust’s 6.8% Distribution Yield Safe?
A 6.8% yield looks tempting, but we examine whether Mapletree Logistics Trust can sustain its distributions.
Keppel DC REIT vs CICT: Which REIT Would I Buy Today?
Two established REITs offer different growth prospects. We compare which presents the more compelling opportunity.
SGX Just Got 4 New Xtrackers ETFs: Which One Should Investors Choose?
Four new ETFs offer exposure to AI and Asian markets. We explore their differences and potential portfolio roles.
